description: This file defines the internal 'MessageFactory' class used in Orleans' messaging system, responsible for creating various message types like requests, responses, and rejections, and managing message correlation IDs and diagnostics.

classes.name: MessageFactory
classes.description: Internal class responsible for creating and managing Orleans messages, including request, response, rejection, and diagnostic messages, with support for unique correlation IDs and detailed logging.

methods.name: CreateMessage
methods.description: Creates a request message with specified body and invocation options, assigning a unique correlation ID.

methods.name: CreateResponseMessage
methods.description: Creates a response message based on a request, copying relevant fields.

methods.name: CreateRejectionResponse
methods.description: Creates a rejection response message indicating an error or rejection type, with optional exception details.

methods.name: CreateDiagnosticResponseMessage
methods.description: Creates a status response message with diagnostic details.

methods.name: GetNextCorrelationId
methods.description: Generates a unique correlation ID combining a seed and an incremented counter.
